For example, in cases where a person receives a promotion at work, they may feel pressure by coworkers or bosses to take advantage of the perks that promotion enables, even if those perks don’t align with their goals, values or personal interests. From an ethical perspective, avoiding FOMO can sometimes be a positive factor in your decisions, especially when that decision is made spontaneously in a moment of impulsivity.
